scripts.test:all: npm run test:ai && npm run test:ai2 && npm run test:ai3a && npm run test:ai3b && npm run test:ai3c && npm run test:security && npm run test:phase4a
scripts.dev: (npm run db:up || echo 'Docker not available, assuming DB is already running natively') && npm run db:check && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on tcp:localhost:5001 -t 30000 && npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.mobile:sync: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: cd frontend && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: cd frontend && npx cap open ios
